submitted.rationale: Of the three compositions measured, Pb0.74Sb0.26 had the highest EQE (0.0313%). The Pb-rich side absorbs at 2.4 eV because of Pb2+ lone-pair states and lead-oxide-like phases. The composition near the 1:1 pyrochlore ratio was about 10x lower, and the most Pb-rich one tested (0.85 Pb) was lower too. So the peak is probably between Pb fractions of about 0.7 and 0.8.
